title: Swan-Ganz Thermodilution and Extravascular Pressure Transducer (RLC) Interactive Simulator
description:
Browser-based teaching simulator for pulmonary artery (Swan-Ganz) catheterisation, indicator thermodilution (Stewart-Hamilton), mixed venous oximetry and the Fick principle, and the dynamics of extravascular pressure transducers modelled as a second-order RLC hydraulic-electrical analogue (RK4 solver, Bode plots, Gardner adequacy chart, fast-flush test).

Designed as an interdisciplinary laboratory for biomedical engineering, medicine and critical care nursing, with field-specific exercises, an exam mode with printable debriefing, and five languages (Italian, English, French, German, Spanish).

Educational use only. This software is not a medical device and must not be used for clinical decisions or patient care.
